title: One Mastery Threshold Does Not Fit All Knowledge Tracing Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.00095v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tutoring systems use mastery thresholds to decide when students can stop practicing and advance, but the same numerical threshold can lead to very different decisions when the underlying knowledge tracing (KT) model changes. We examine six KT models across four public educational datasets and evaluate 12 thresholds from 0.50 to 0.99 using post-advancement performance, advancement coverage, practice burden, and disparities across prior-performance groups. We also identify thresholds that balance performance, extra practice, and advancement under 30 predefined instructional settings. Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) is relatively insensitive to threshold changes, while neural models become much more selective as thresholds increase. This partly reflects different model outputs: BKT estimates latent mastery probability, whereas neural models estimate the probability of a correct next response, so the same cutoff does not represent the same

translated_title: 一个掌握度阈值并不适用于所有知识追踪模型
translated_abstract: 辅导系统使用掌握度阈值来决定学生何时可以停止练习并晋级，但当底层的知识追踪（KT）模型发生变化时，相同的数值阈值可能导致截然不同的决策。我们在四个公开教育数据集上考察了六种KT模型，并使用晋级后表现、晋级覆盖率、练习负担以及不同先前成绩群体之间的差异等指标，评估了从0.50到0.99的12个阈值。我们还在30个预定义的教学场景下识别了能够平衡表现、额外练习和晋级机会的阈值。研究发现，贝叶斯知识追踪（BKT）对阈值变化相对不敏感，而神经模型随着阈值提高变得更加挑剔。这部分反映了模型输出的差异：BKT估计的是潜在掌握概率，而神经模型估计的是下一次回答正确的概率，因此相同的截止值并不代表相同的意义……
tldr: 该研究系统评估了六种知识追踪模型在四个数据集上对12个掌握度阈值的响应，发现统一阈值在不同模型间导致截然不同的晋级决策——BKT对阈值不敏感而神经模型高度敏感，其根源在于两类模型输出含义不同，因此不应为所有KT模型使用同一个掌握度阈值。
en_tdlr: The same mastery threshold produces vastly different advancement decisions across knowledge tracing models—BKT is relatively insensitive while neural models become highly selective as thresholds rise, because the two model types estimate fundamentally different quantities—so no single mastery threshold fits all KT models.
